title: Pullback in Uptrend
briefing: Meadow Pharma is trending up, but its pullbacks are sharp. Value Vera loves a dip. Buy the right ones and know when a dip is something more.
objective: Buy pullbacks inside an uptrend with a stop, and recognize when a pullback becomes a breakdown.
debrief: Meadow Pharma's uptrend had three sharp pullbacks: the rival launch (day 4), the pricing review (day 11) and the share sale (day 18). Each one bounced. The trial halt on day 25 was different: a real change in the business, and the stock kept falling. A disciplined player bought the pullbacks with stops just below the lows and was stopped out quickly when the last one failed.

news.headline: A rival launches a similar allergy drug
news.body: Analysts expect Meadow to keep most of its market share.

news.headline: Doctors stick with Meadow's allergy drug
news.body: An industry survey shows few doctors plan to switch.

news.headline: Government to review drug prices
news.body: The review could take a year; no changes are planned yet.

news.headline: Review will not cover recently approved drugs
news.body: Meadow's newest medicines are outside the scope of the review.

news.headline: A large fund sells Meadow Pharma shares
news.body: The fund says it is rebalancing after a strong run.

news.headline: Meadow Pharma announces a share buyback
news.body: The company will buy back about 2% of its shares.

news.headline: Meadow Pharma halts a heart-drug trial over side effects
news.body: The company will review the data before deciding the trial's future.

basic.text: Finish with more profit than your opponent

bonus.text: Place a stop-loss order (aim just below a pullback low)
Be out of Meadow Pharma by day 27, after the trial halt
